items.docs:
Returns a list of Companies from ZoomInfo's data which meet the specified search criteria.

Input parameters may require specific values, some of which are too extensive to list in the parameter descriptions. You can retrieve these values using the [Lookup](#efe7b4b8-1ef2-4fcd-a20f-9da68f6b2055) endpoints.

**Input params**

| Parameter | DataType | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rpp | Integer | Limits the results returned to the given number of results per page. Default is 25. |
| page | I
Returns a list of fields you can use as input for the [Company Search](#4506f0ad-9147-4016-991f-ce8ef6700f07) endpoint.
Returns a list of fields included in the response for the [Company Search](#4506f0ad-9147-4016-991f-ce8ef6700f07) endpoint.
